label: ProductForge-Dashboard Backlog 73
title: MVP: Ideas workspace - idea-only intake, review/follow-up, promote-to-project, consolidate multiple ideas
body: A workspace for IDEAS received via intake that have no project: list/filter/search; review now or park with follow-up; promote an idea to a new project; or CONSOLIDATE multiple selected idea entries and have the system analyze them and produce an outcome (consolidated idea / project brief / backlog items). Depends on backend BI (forge:idea-consolidation).
